name: Schneeschuhwanderung Arlberg
beschreibung:
=== description ===
Enjoy the winter silence away from the ski runs: With snowshoes and an experienced mountain guide, you’ll wander through the deep powder snow of the **Arlberg**. Along the way, you’ll pass snow-covered huts and magical forests, eventually reaching a viewpoint with breathtaking panoramic views. The perfect finish is a hearty *Jause* (snack meal) in a cozy hut with mulled wine.
